accepted.workload_contract: gateway health plus one CRUD request
accepted.hypothesis: Killing the api-gateway pod will cause the entire pet/owner/visit flow to fail, as it is the sole entrypoint for all client requests.
accepted.expected_invariant: The gateway health check and the CRUD request will fail, but downstream services remain healthy.
accepted.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on api-gateway, then send a CRUD request and check gateway health.
accepted.recovery_expectation: Restarting the api-gateway pod should restore service, assuming no persistent state loss.
accepted.weakness_surface: Single point of failure at the ingress layer; no redundancy or failover for the gateway.

accepted.workload_contract: gateway health plus one CRUD request
accepted.hypothesis: Killing the discovery-server will cause service discovery failures across all dependent services, breaking inter-service communication and the API flow.
accepted.expected_invariant: The API flow will fail due to inability to resolve service endpoints, but the discovery-server itself is not in the request path.
accepted.validation_plan: Inject pod_kill on discovery-server, then send a CRUD request and observe failures in service-to-service calls.
accepted.recovery_expectation: Restarting discovery-server should allow services to re-register and recover, assuming no persistent state loss.
accepted.weakness_surface: Centralized service registry; all services depend on it for locating each other.
